_doc: Paint, refutation round 4 (2026-11-23), after round 3's fix, on 20 more boxes (refute.py r4: junctions at s 218, 929, 1500, 2100, 2640, 3000, 3940, 4660, 5300, 6440; mid-block at s 260, 1100, 1250, 1880, 2500, 3300, 3900, 4450, 4800, 6000). 12 boxes were read (three sheets of four); j2100 and j3940 had been seen in round 1 and are not fresh; j6440 is a signal node off the corridor and its box is empty. Counts by eye, approximate; j2100 (under the 2022 shadow) is left out of the detected count.
false_measured_were: off-street parking stripes inside the look-window (2), the light-rail slab's edges on Stout / Speer (4), a pair of 'bars' on a red car (2), a kerb's curve (2), one line in the 15th St shadow (1)
missed_were: lane dashes on Stout's concrete, dotted guides and a few crosswalk bars at Speer / Colfax, dashes hidden by vehicles in every year
new_causes: none. Every false mark and miss belongs to a class already named in rounds 1-3 and left unfixed for the reasons given there. The loop stops here.
not_typed_and_visible_in_these_boxes: BUS legends on red panels (the panels are in the file as surfaces), bicycle symbols, green crossbike blocks
